title: Gabriele Beccari, PhD
text:
Continue to site

    














Hello there! I am a Data Scientist with a strong background in economics, currently working in Data Analytics and Governance for Banca Popolare Etica, the largest Italian bank committed to the principles of Ethical Finance.
I earned a PhD in Economics and Finance from the “Tor Vergata” University of Rome and completed a postdoctoral fellowship at the Scuola Normale Superiore.
Originally from Florence and now based in Rome, I also spent one year in Ireland.
